newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific Gateway started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific Gateway started.

text.p: Montgomery Securities analyst Bill Vogel said he initiated coverage of Pacific Gateway Exchange Inc with a buy rating and set a $53 target price over the next 12 to 18 months.
The international long distance service provider was up 1/2 at 36 at the opening of trading on Friday.
The analyst said he expected the company to report $0.14 per share for the second quarter of 1997 versus the $0.05 per share it reported in the 1996 second quarter.
He set estimates for the 1997 year of $0.59 per share, for 1998 of $0.93 and for the 1999 year of $1.33.
Based on his 1999 year projection, Vogel the stock deserves a 40 times price-to-earnings multiple.
